svg.text: Each step of the bound puts its own weight on the noise error.
DDPM's simple loss replaces every one of them with 1.
the simple loss: 1 at every step
DDPM step t, 1,000 steps, linear schedule
inside the bound: 55× between largest and smallest
The dropped weights favour nearly clean steps. Setting
them to 1 turns those down and trains the harder ones.
WHERE THE DIFFUSION MSE LOSS COMES FROM · CANERY.IN
